title: Position: Certified Correctness in Neural Constraint Reasoning Requires Symbolic Integration
abstract: arXiv:2608.14569v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural solvers for constraint satisfaction problems have achieved remarkable in-distribution accuracy, yet they suffer from a fundamental limitation persistent constraint violations occur under distribution shifts even when the model reports high confidence. This position paper argues that when hard constraints exist and the cost of verification is relatively low, neural constraint reasoning must prioritize symbolic integration over pure learning. We justify our focus on Sudoku as a representative NP-complete testbed because it exhibits a sharp asymmetry between easy verification and hard solving: checking a candidate solution requires only polynomial time $O(n^{2})$, while finding a solution may require exponential search. translated_title: 立场：神经约束推理中的认证正确性需要符号集成
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14569v1 公告类型：新 摘要：用于约束满足问题的神经求解器在分布内精度上取得了显著成就，但它们存在一个根本性局限：即使在模型报告高置信度的情况下，在分布偏移下仍会出现持续性的约束违反。本立场论文认为，当存在硬约束且验证成本相对较低时，神经约束推理必须优先考虑符号集成而非纯学习。我们选择数独作为代表性的NP完全测试平台，是因为它展示了易验证与难求解之间的尖锐不对称性：检查候选解仅需多项式时间$O(n^{2})$，而寻找解可能需要指数搜索。通过对求解方法的全面综述，涵盖确定性算法、元启发式优化、基于学习的方法以及语言条件推理，我们证明纯神经方法在...
tldr: 本文主张在存在硬约束且验证成本低时，神经约束推理必须结合符号集成以确保正确性，并以数独为例论证纯学习方法在分布偏移下不可靠。
en_tdlr: This paper argues that neural constraint reasoning must integrate symbolic methods to ensure correctness when hard constraints exist and verification is cheap, using Sudoku to show pure learning fails under distribution shifts.
